title: mentha × rotundifolia f. lepteilema
intro: Mentha × rotundifolia f. lepteilema, commonly known as peppermint, is a hybrid subspecies of the mint plant that is known for its distinctive minty aroma and flavor. Peppermint is rich in various health benefits, including reducing nausea and headaches, alleviating digestive issues, and providing relief from stress and anxiety. Its therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which make it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of peppermint include menthol, menthone, limonene, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal and aromatic properties.
